summary: ProjectManager.run_cycle pauses on durable critical/exhausted budget or would_pause_next_cycle even when autonomy enabled=false or risk_tolerance=off, matching surface-gate doctrine for what_next/costs feed (#634/#785).
migration_impact: PM cycles may pause under risk=off when spend leaves remaining below per_cycle. Operators raise token_budget or wait for UTC day rollover / reset spend to resume.
agent_notes: Do not treat risk=off as permission to assign work when budget_pressure is critical or would_pause_next_cycle is true. Resolve budget_gate first.
